about: W1's known exceptions on this map (tools/world/graph-check.mjs): each class is counted and passes up to its count and its worst, as a person read them in a reviewed bake; past either it fails. The studio's calls are in docs/specs/earth/GRAPHS.md, 'Where the ground wins'; the walls along the decks are the next pass's. A map with no file has none. Set from the bake of 2026-11-05 (osm7), each worst 0.1 m over tonight's.

heldNodes.what: a node where a ground way meets a drawn deck mid-span, on the deck's top (call 3: the Golden Gate's north tower)

heldSteps.what: steps of those ways climbing to it

feet.what: sidewalk steps at their own feet on the ground beside their road still up (call 1)

held.what: sidewalk steps the ground holds over their road (call 2)

otherRoad.what: sidewalk steps riding a road within 1 m that isn't the nearest

walls.what: foot deck steps rising over 1 m faster than a ramp's 50 % (a stair's 77.5 % on stairs): at feet the calls' and pits in the grid, along the decks riding that flips between two carriageways and the Bay Bridge's cycleway; found 2026-11-05, not fixed
